channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Why are so many dead bumblebees appearing on sidewalks?
item.description: Bumblebees have short natural lifespans, but extreme heat and human activity are making survival even harder, with pesticides harming them.

item.title: NSF launches pilot for four-year Ph.D. programs with industry placements
item.description: The U.S. National Science Foundation announced a $47 million investment over five years, with additional commitments from nearly three dozen partners.

item.title: Can't sleep in the heat? These 8 tricks could save your night
item.description: Sleeping well during a heatwave starts with preventing the home from overheating. Close blinds against strong sunlight, ventilate when the air outside is cooler.

item.title: Your gut may help your brain decide what to remember
item.description: Signals from the gut to the brain may help turn meals into lasting memories. Rats showed stronger memory activity after consuming nutritious food.
